newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nomura to lead manage jumbo euroyen by Greece.
newsitem.headline: Nomura to lead manage jumbo euroyen by Greece.

text.p: Greece has named Nomura Securities Co Ltd to lead manage about 100 billion yen worth of euroyen bonds due to be launched next week, an underwriter at Nomura said on Friday.
"We are planning to launch the Greek bonds next week," the underwriter said.
The bonds will be offered in two tranches, comprising 50 billion yen each of 10-year and 20-year bonds. The 10-year bond will be jointly lead managed by Goldman Sachs, the underwriter added.
In July last year, Greece raised a total of 130 billion yen through the samurai market in three tranches via Nomura. The bonds had six-, 12- and 20-year maturities.
Greece is rated Baa1 by Moody's Investors Service and triple B minus (BBB-) by Standard & Poor's.
